versions.changelog:
Initial public release of the LDM Inbox Check MCP skill.

- Integrates paid inbox-placement testing for OpenClaw agents using the ldm-inbox-check-mcp MCP server.
- Adds tools for creating, listing, and checking status of real-time inbox tests with provider-level detail.
- Supports domain monitoring utilities and reporting formats.
- Enforces quota usage, pass/fail policy, and workflow discipline to avoid unnecessary paid tests.
- Securely manages API keys and prohibits exposing sensitive credentials.
